The [MATH: x]-intercept of the graph [MATH: y = h(t)] is the point where the graph intersects the [MATH: x]-axis. At this point, [MATH: y = 0,] and so it corresponds to the moment when the drone reaches the ground.

To find the [MATH: x]-intercept, we set [MATH: y = 0] and solve: [MATH: 0|= h(t); 0|= 120 − 15t; 15t|= 120; t|= 8]

This means the drone takes [MATH: 8] seconds to reach the ground after it starts descending.

So, the [MATH: x]-coordinate of the [MATH: x]-intercept represents the number of seconds it takes for the drone to reach the ground.

Therefore, the correct answer is only IV.
